name: Good Joss
body:
Sutra Type charm [positive energy]

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Range touch
Target one creature

EFFECT

Duration 1 round/effective spell level or discharged (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

The bearer of this sutra receives a +1 luck bonus with an additional +1 per 5 sutra caster levels.

At the time the ofuda is crafted, determine one type of d20 roll. Apply the bonus to those rolls. The bonus can be applied to attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks, or ability checks. Unlike other ofuda, this one can be activated only by the bearer; even if the bearer is not a sutra caster. Activating this sutra requires a standard action by the bearer. This sutra has a duration in rounds equal to its effective spell level.
